title: AG-UI forwardedProps
description: `RunAgentInput.forwardedProps`: per-request only, never persisted. MAF drops metadata values whose serialized form exceeds 512 characters, so the serialized object must stay far below 512 characters. additionalProperties=false and the enums guarantee that (max ~60 characters); never add free-text fields here. `context[]` is not part of the contract (ignored by MAF). Anything that must persist belongs in the state instead.
